period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), Solo basis, from First Security Islami Bank PLC's own Condensed Balance Sheet (Un-audited) as at 2024-09-30. Income-statement items with a '_cumulative' suffix are cumulative from 1 January of the same year; items with a '_discrete_q' suffix are the single discrete quarter alone -- both are printed directly as separate columns in the source document (not derived by subtraction), so both carry basis='reported'. The comparative prior-year-end Total Assets column in this filing cross-validates exactly (to the taka, after rounding) against this dataset's already-stored 659,114.06mn (2023_Q4.json) total_assets figure, confirming Solo basis continuity and no restatement between the audited annual figure and this interim filing's own comparative column. Cumulative (Jan-Sep) and discrete (Jul-Sep) columns both directly reported, filed/signed 2024-10-31. THIS IS THE FIRST QUARTER WHERE THE COLLAPSE BECOMES VISIBLE IN THE BOTTOM LINE: Jul-Sep 2024 (discrete) swung to a NET LOSS of BDT -274.93mn, versus a profit of BDT +363.98mn in the same quarter of 2023 -- Total Operating Income (discrete) nearly halved year-over-year (BDT 2,380.54mn vs BDT 3,628.80mn) and Profit/(Loss) before Provision and Tax (discrete) was already negative (BDT -120.19mn) before additional provisions. 9-month cumulative Net Profit After Tax fell to BDT +614.30mn (down ~60% from 9m-2023's BDT +1,553.56mn) -- the bank was STILL cumulatively profitable through September 2024. Cumulative Specific Provision for Classified Investment reached BDT +1,800.39mn for the 9 months (i.e. ~BDT 1,206.61mn charged in Q3 alone, ~2.7x Q2's charge) -- a clear, accelerating, real-time-disclosed early-warning trend (Q1 +144.53mn -> Q2 +449.25mn -> Q3 +1,206.61mn, each quarter roughly 3x the last) visible a full 7-8 months before the FY2024 audited financial statements were finalized. IMPORTANT DERIVED OBSERVATION (not a reported figure, calculated here transparently from two genuinely-reported numbers): subtracting this filing's own 9-month cumulative Net Profit After Tax (BDT +614.30mn) from the FY2024 full-year Net Profit After Tax already stored in this dataset's 2024_Q4.json (BDT -3,993.40mn) implies a Q4-2024-alone (Oct-Dec) net loss of approximately BDT -4,607.70mn -- i.e. MORE THAN THE ENTIRE REPORTED FULL-YEAR LOSS, and roughly 3.8x the size of any single quarter's deterioration visible in this bank's own interim filings. CONCLUSION: the collapse was NOT fully hidden until the audit -- a real, accelerating, quantifiable deterioration (swinging profit-to-loss, provisions roughly tripling quarter-on-quarter) was visible in the bank's own unaudited interim filings from Q2 2024 onward -- but the CATASTROPHIC scale (Classified Investments 3.95%->91.75%, Solo CRAR 12-13%->4.92%, fraud findings) was recognized suddenly and specifically in Q4 2024, concurrent with or driven by the year-end audit process (the qualified audit opinion cites a Bangladesh Bank assessment letter dated 27/04/2025, i.e. during the audit, not during the year). No classified-investment percentage or CRAR is disclosed in any of this bank's condensed interim (Q1/H1/Q3) filings at any point in 2024 -- that information only ever surfaced in the year-end audited statements.

line_items.metric_note: Cumulative charge (or, if negative, net reversal) for specific provision against classified investments since 1 January. This is the only asset-quality-adjacent figure disclosed in this un-audited interim filing -- the bank's Classified Investment amount/percentage and CRAR are NOT disclosed at interim (Q1/H1/Q3) frequency, only in the annual audited financial statements.

line_items.original_metric_name: Investment / Deposit (calculated: Total Investment / Deposits and Other Accounts)
line_items.metric_note: Simple Investment/Deposit calculation per this dataset's standard formula (methodology.md). This does NOT match the bank's own regulatory-basis 'Investment Deposit Ratio' as separately disclosed in annual reports (e.g. FY2024 annual reports 122.25% vs this simple calculation giving ~141% at FY2024 year-end) -- the bank's own regulatory ratio evidently uses a different deposit/investment base (e.g. including borrowings or a regulatory-defined denominator) not disclosed in these condensed interim statements. Recorded as a internally-consistent, comparable-across-quarters proxy, not as a reproduction of the bank's own regulatory ratio.
